Noble Revenance: Drukhari Kabal units with at least 1 model within 6" that can draw line of sight to this model can use this model's Leadership characteristic.

Perfect Cruelty: While this model is leading a unit that has used at least 1 Pain Token to access either of (or both of) the Critical Hits and Critical Wounds abilities, attacks made by that unit instead score Critical Hits and/or Critical Wounds on a 4+ instead of a 5+.

Pleasure from Pain: When you spend a Pain Token on this model (or a unit being led by this model), increase this model's Leadership characteristic to 3+ until the end of the Battle Round.

Grim Grace: While this model is leading a unit, when that unit uses the Charge and Fight action:

  • Models in the unit can make Pile-In and Consolidation moves over enemy models as if they were not there, but must be able to end those moves in base-to-base contact with at least 1 enemy model.
  • Melee attacks made by the unit gain the Lance ability. If an attack is already benefitting from that ability, increase its Strength characteristic by 1 instead.
  • Models in the unit gain the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

Spectacle of Blades: While this model is leading a unit that has spent a Pain Token, melee attacks made by the unit have the Sustained Hits 1 ability. If an attack is already benefitting from the Sustained Hits [X] ability, increase [X] by 1 instead.

sections.prose:
My Faithful Wretches: While this model is leading a Wracks unit, that unit gains the Bodyguard keyword.

Experimental Concoctions: While this model is leading a Wracks unit, it can choose to use this ability. To do so, during your Command Phase, declare that this model will be using Experimental Concoctions on the unit it is leading. For the remainder of the Battle Round, each Pain Token spent on the unit provides 2 Power From Pain abilities. However, until the end of the Battle Round:

  • If 1 Pain Token are spent on the unit while this ability is in effect, attacks made by the unit have the Hazardous 1 ability.
  • If 2 Pain Tokens are spent on the unit while this ability is in effect, attacks made by the unit have the Hazardous D3 ability.
  • If 3 Pain Tokens are spent on the unit while this ability is in effect, attacks made by the unit have the Hazardous D3+1 ability, and the Hazardous ability triggers on a roll of a 1, 2 or 3.

Pain Engineer: While this model is within 6" of a friendly Pain Engine unit, it can use this ability when it is activated. To do so, use the Mission Task Action as part of this model's activation and roll a D6:

  • On a roll of a 1, 2 or 3, 1 model from the Pain Engine unit regains D3+1 lost Wounds, and the unit gains 1 Pain Token that can be used the next time it is activated.
  • On a roll of a 4, 5 or 6, the unit regains D3+3 lost Wounds, and gains 3 Pain Tokens that can be used the next time the unit is activated. However, attacks made by the unit have the Hazardous D3+1 ability until the end of the Battle Round.

This model can be equipped with a Voidshield.

Any weapon this model is equipped with (excluding Grenade weapons) can be upgraded as a Master-Crafted weapon.
